display_title: The Lucky Plan of An Idol In His Second Life
description:
Won Yu-Ha, a trainee who was unfairly robbed of the chance to appear on a survival program that was expected to be a huge hit, became a 'loser'. After six years of struggling to lead the members who had no motivation, a series of scandals among the members and a sudden traffic accident resulted in him being declared ineligible for a comeback.

 *"If I were born again, I would never become an idol."*

Just when he was about to give up on life, determined to never dream of such a life again, "Appearing on Design Your Idol. You'll give it to me, right?" He returned to six years ago when he missed the opportunity of a lifetime... ?

『Tutorial: The Crossroads of Life! Spin the Roulette and Decide Your Life!』

And what is this thing that just popped up before his eyes?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
